state:
Goal `core-math-1-3`, stage 2 (the dossier). `Core\Math::abs`, `acos`, `acosh`, `asin`, `asinh`, `atan` and `atan2` have every feature proof on disk: `about.md`, three examples, one attack, one bench with a recorded figure, a Rust `#[test]` with a `covers:` marker in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/math.rs`'s test module, and help. `Core\Math` has its class card, so the class-card part of help is done for every member of the class.
`abs`'s example 03 carries `// proof: gap nvs-stdlib/math-abs-result-is-the-whole-union`. `abs` is typed `int|float|decimal` whatever it is given, so `decimal $owed = Core\Math::abs($x)` does not compile. The fix needs a bounded type variable, which is a design question (M10).
Member cards are rewritten in plain words as each member is taken (`ABS_DOC` to `ATAN2_DOC` done). Do the same for each card you take.
`Core\Math::round` takes its precision as an option: `Core\Math::round($x, {precision: 1})`, never a second plain argument. `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only <id> <id>` records several figures in one call; `--id` takes one.
The WSL leg's copy now links `target` to the leg's target directory (`tools/nv/driver/mirror.ts`'s `targetLine`), so `examples/process.nvs` finds `target/debug/nvs` and its grant there again.
